premises.text: Growing third-party and partner data volumes make inter-company data management hard technically and operationally
premises.evidence_span: This explosion in data makes managing inter-company data very hard, both technically and operationally

premises.text: A data operations platform handles giving and getting data—secure, smart, no-code scalable ops with encryption, access control, anonymization, and schema/quality/volume alerts
premises.evidence_span: Nexla is a data operations platform that takes care of how you give and get the data so that you can focus on how to use the data

premises.text: In-house builds are unjustifiably hard and existing tools cannot handle inter-company monitoring, security, and operational scale across infrastructures
premises.evidence_span: Existing solutions, meanwhile, cannot handle inter-company data with its needs for monitoring, security, and operational scale

value.text: Teams spend less time integrating and more time creating business value while scaling data operations
value.evidence_span: Less time integrating, more time creating business value

causal_links.evidence_span: focus on how to use the data
making data operations a highly secure, scalable, and repeatable process

notes: Easy/secure/smart features and demo transforms (scan, annotate, precision reduce, filter, share, MySQL, anomaly monitor) folded as feature cascade of one data-ops platform (v1.5.1 §4.1.7). Closed-beta logos excluded as traction. Cloud-computing analogy treated as framing, not a premise. Anti-template: pain, product, and competitive gap are separately revisable.
